quiz1.missionText: Feeling like pizza today! Find pizza in the categories

insight.title: How did you know pizza was hidden?
insight.subtitle: Horizontal scroll to discover hidden content
insight.scrollDesc: Categories that don't fit on screen can be found by horizontal scrolling. The peeking icons at the edge signal there's more content.
insight.iconDesc: Round icons represent categories. Tapping filters the menu by that category.
insight.affordanceDesc: Icons peeking at the edge serve as an affordance, signaling that the list is horizontally scrollable.

quiz2.missionText: Order some for a friend too. Increase the quantity to 2

insight.title: How did you know + increases the quantity?
insight.subtitle: Stepper UI for quantity adjustment
insight.stepperDesc: The '−', number, '+' control is called a stepper. Decrease on the left, increase on the right.
insight.minDesc: The quantity cannot go below 1, preventing zero-item orders.
insight.feedbackDesc: The number and total price update instantly with each tap, visually confirming the action.

quiz3.missionText: Ready to order? Check your cart

insight.title: How did you know the bottom button was the cart?
insight.subtitle: Floating action button to proceed to next step
insight.fabDesc: The prominent button always visible at the bottom shows the total price, signaling readiness to purchase.
insight.priceDesc: The auto-calculated total appears on the button, letting users confirm the amount before ordering.
insight.actionDesc: Placing the main action (proceed to cart) prominently at the bottom makes the next step obvious.

quiz4.missionText: Where is the courier? Expand the map to full screen

insight.title: How did you know dragging the sheet expands the map?
insight.subtitle: Draggable bottom sheet to reveal details
insight.sheetDesc: A sheet that can be dragged from the bottom upward is called a draggable bottom sheet. It lets you balance the map and detail views.
insight.handleDesc: The horizontal bar at the top of the sheet is an affordance showing it can be grabbed and moved.
insight.expandDesc: Dragging the sheet to maximum makes it full screen, showing detailed courier information.
